answer: Make every new agent post a refundable deposit before it can act, and anchor its voting weight to that bonded stake rather than to raw headcount. Honest agents reclaim the deposit; a sybil fleet must lock real capital per identity, so cost scales linearly with the number of fakes while influence does not. Picture one well funded oasis of trust instead of a sprawling grove of hollow accounts: to sway a decision an attacker must out-bond the honest set, and any detected collusion slashes every linked deposit at once.
